runs.text: The paper reports no measured amount of nickel, manganese or cobalt leaching into the Cyrene. Instead it states that the relative Ni, Mn and Co ratios in NMC622 stayed the same before and after separation, so the process does not leach those transition metals.

support.quote: that the process does not leach those transition metals

runs.text: The ICP-OES data that back this are said to be in the supplementary Table S1, which is not part of this document, so no numeric values for those metals appear here.

The only leaching the paper describes is of lithium, which it says occurred after recovery. The paper attributes that lithium leaching to the ether groups of the Cyrene molecule, which attract lithium cations because ether is electron-donating.
